warning: These EXAMPLE rules exist solely to exercise the scenario test framework. They are NOT production prevention rules and must be replaced by the teammate's reviewed rules.

rules.description: Demo: escalation on high risk with rising trend
rules.action: [DEMO] Activate response-team standby and review site safety checklist
rules.explanation: [DEMO] High/elevated risk that is still rising warrants proactive preparedness

rules.description: Demo: tighter monitoring on moderate stable risk
rules.action: [DEMO] Increase observation frequency to twice daily
rules.explanation: [DEMO] Moderate but non-improving situations benefit from closer watch

rules.description: Demo: routine posture for low decreasing risk
rules.explanation: [DEMO] Low and non-rising conditions require no special measures

rules.description: Demo: heavy single-day rainfall awareness modifier
rules.action: [DEMO] Issue situational-awareness note to field staff
rules.explanation: [DEMO] Very heavy daily rainfall deserves explicit communication regardless of level band
